voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Fort Lauderdale, December fifth, nineteen forty-five. Five Navy Avenger bombers took off on a training flight. Fourteen men.
The flight leader radioed that his compasses had failed. He believed he was over the Florida Keys.
The radio calls faded into static. They never came back.
That night, a flying boat with thirteen men went out to search. It was never heard from again.
The Navy's board recorded causes or reasons unknown. No wreckage of the five bombers has ever been found.
